rules.staging: 291be55e5 controller stages Change ops, labels and undo predictions; changes.ts sends immediately in staging order and engine owns order
rules.positions: 291be55e5 move/placement index API becomes reorder/PagePosition neighbour or start/end; positionOf validates refs before sizeAt, even with explicit size
rules.validation: refsOf requires nonempty and pageOf existence; rotateBy type is quarter/half turns and PdfRotation required on every PageLayout
rules.permissions: controller refuse checks assemble/download then caller signal; duplicate also asserts download; other document extract is source engine authority
rules.registry: documents consumes full confirmed layout facts, events before promise settlement; returned result alone does not update registry
rules.history: rotationOf folds pending shows, rotate groups all ops into one change with undo groups; extraction sends holds and waits for changes.whenSettled
rules.lifetime: close cancels change queue with instance-closed; captured capability authority remains readable but writes cannot stage
rules.boundaries: Fake table supplies explicit typed engine facts/results only. No actual PDF parsing/editing claim; actual shipping controller/kernel/change queue execute.
